article.p: YouTube hosts several public stills for most videos. A maxres file, when published, is usually 1280×720. If that file is missing, the extractor ranks the next valid public size. Details are in the thumbnail size guide and the highest quality thumbnail page.
A YouTube thumbnail is the preview image shown for a video or Short. This tool finds the publicly available image files YouTube hosts for that video.
article.h3: How do I download a YouTube thumbnail?
article.p: Paste a public YouTube URL, wait for the available sizes to appear, then choose Download. Processing happens in your browser.
article.h3: What is the highest available YouTube thumbnail resolution?
article.p: When YouTube published a maxres file, it is usually 1280×720. If that file is missing, the extractor selects the next valid public size.
article.h3: How do I get a YouTube thumbnail URL?
article.p: After extraction, use Copy image URL on the size you want. That copies the direct image address from YouTube public image hosts.
article.h3: Can I download thumbnails from YouTube Shorts?
article.p: Yes. Shorts URLs are supported the same way as regular video URLs, as long as the thumbnail files are public.
Common public files include default, mqdefault, hqdefault, sddefault, and maxresdefault. The tool only lists sizes that actually exist for that video.
article.h3: Do I need to install software?
article.p: No. The extractor runs in the browser. You do not install an app or browser extension.
article.h3: Does the tool store my YouTube links?
article.p: Pasted URLs are processed in the browser. They are not sent to an 11tik server. Optional local history stays on your device until you clear it.
Yes. There is no account and no paid download of the thumbnail files.
article.h3: How does the thumbnail extractor work?
article.p: It reads the video ID from a supported YouTube URL, checks public thumbnail image URLs, validates which files exist, and ranks the highest available image.
